# Aniday

> Aniday is a global recruitment platform enabling direct connections between candidates, employers, and headhunters with specialized job listings, EOR/PEO services, and remote hiring across Asia-Pacific.

Aniday specializes in high-paying positions across technology, design, marketing, and administrative roles, primarily serving Asia-Pacific job seekers and international employers. The platform facilitates direct communication and provides comprehensive employment services including payroll and global hiring solutions.

## Core Platform

- [Aniday Recruitment Platform](https://aniday.com): Main platform for direct chat between candidates, employers, and headhunters with global hiring and EOR/PEO services
- [All Job Listings](https://aniday.com/en/job): Complete job listings across industries with global employers and headhunter opportunities

## Technology & Engineering Jobs

- [IT Jobs](https://aniday.com/en/job-it-cr1): IT job category with developer roles, competitive salaries, and career growth opportunities
- [Backend Developer Jobs](https://aniday.com/en/job-backend-developer-cr4): Backend developer positions in Java, .NET, Golang with remote Asia-Pacific roles
- [Software Engineer Jobs](https://aniday.com/en/job-software-engineer-cr10): Software engineer roles including backend, full-stack positions in Asia-Pacific and remote
- [Unity Developer Jobs](https://aniday.com/en/job-unity-developers-cr7): Unity game developer jobs for mobile development with remote Asia-Pacific hiring
- [PHP Developer Jobs](https://aniday.com/en/job-php-developers-cr9): PHP developer positions for web programming with remote Asia job listings
